notes: Technical Communication with original data, so not a review or other non-primary document. record.json has is_retracted false and the PDF carries no retraction notice. Not duplicate_data: the paper does not state that its uptake values were published before; refs [10] and [11] are cited only for sample preparation and the apparatus. Only one file (main) is present, no supplementary information. Sorbent is pristine single-layer graphene powder (C/O ratio 10.8-14.9 per XPS), so majority carbon. Additional conditions: 290 K up to 6 MPa, reported only as a bound ('below 0.2 wt.%'); 77 K and 87 K isotherms up to 100 kPa in Fig. 2. Isosteric heat in Fig. 3 is derived, not an uptake value.
